_doc: Log of analysis METHOD changes (how information is gathered, what is written). Every change, even a small one, adds an entry; the highest version is ANALYSIS_VERSION. A page made with an older version shows the later entries and a targeted request to paste to Claude. 'title' is shown on the pages (French). 'auto': true = fixed by rerunning the listed scripts, no text to rewrite. 'todo' = what Claude must do on an existing page, and only that.

changes.title: Analyse initiale
changes.todo: Write the intro and the summary of each build.

changes.title: Comment le jouer / le contrer
changes.todo: Run the listed scripts on the folder, then write tldr and plan (early, mid, late, tips, role, abilities 1-4, strengths, weaknesses, vs).

changes.title: Avis des créateurs (vidéos YouTube)
changes.todo: Read the "L'avis des créateurs" section of the counter view (data/videos.json). If a video tip is missing from plan.vs or contradicts an existing point, add a point to plan.vs (or fix the contradicted one), citing it (source video:<id>@<s>) and saying whether the stats confirm it. Touch nothing else.

changes.title: Sources obligatoires pour chaque texte
changes.todo: Add "sources" to summaries.json: for every text path (intro, <build>.resume, <build>.points[i], tldr.*, plan.*), the list of its sources (build:<key>, guide:<n>, video:<id>@<s>, stat:<module>, roles-guide, analyse). Do not rewrite the texts.

changes.title: Phrases complètes et noms complets
changes.todo: Run report.py and fix every "Shortened name" it reports (always the full official name, otherwise no link and no English translation). Reread the texts: every item or ability inside a sentence with a verb ("achète X", "X empêche…"), no telegraphic "… : Name."; the sentence must stay correct when the name switches to English.
